negative_invariants.description: C-003: no Lynn product verdict is cited as evidence anywhere in the deliverable surfaces. No such verdict is recorded; the program-state name 'ready-for-Lynn' and explicit statements that no verdict exists are permitted and are not matched.

HIGH-1 regression guard: no surface prescribes the static wrapper as carrying container-type alone. The wrapper carries the component's complete :host declaration set; the abbreviated rule makes sk-app-shell compute 0px against 300px as a flex item, measured in both engines.
HIGH-1 regression guard, prose form: the #307 freeze guidance and the authoring recipe must not describe the wrapper by naming container-type as the thing 'on the outer element'.

MEDIUM-1 regression guard: no component comment tells a static consumer merely to 'outbid this rule on specificity'. The instruction must state the tie boundary, because an equal-specificity consumer selector resolves by stylesheet order where the element form yielded unconditionally.
